wire.headline: MediLink Announces Major Restructuring and Staff Cuts
sentences: MediLink has announced the closure of 4,800 staff roles as part of a significant organizational change.
The restructuring initiative is set to cut 12% of the company's total workforce.
CEO Marian Holt cited a 3bn GBP savings target as the primary driver for these reductions.
In response to the announcement, shares dropped 4.26bn GBP in market cap.
The company also cut its dividend to 12.4p per share.
The new plan is effective from 4 November.
The final phase of the restructuring is scheduled to complete by March 2027.

PD.headline: Manchester Pharmacy Closure and Staff Support

sentences.text: MediLink has announced that 4,800 staff roles will be closed as part of a significant organizational change.
The Manchester branch is scheduled to close by August 2026.
Local manager Tom Evans resigned this week.
The primary driver for these reductions, according to CEO Marian Holt, was a 3bn GBP savings target.
A community center is hosting a support group for the staff.
The nearest alternative pharmacy is 12 miles away.

ND.headline: Retail Giant Faces Backlash as Restructuring Plan Threatens Jobs and Suppliers

sentences.text: The company's restructuring plan will result in the loss of 12% of its total workforce.
CEO Marian Holt stated that the initiative is designed to meet a 3bn GBP savings target.
The Unite union has announced it will ballot 2,400 members regarding potential strike action.
Union leader Sarah Jones described the proposed plan as reckless.
MP Alan Thorne has demanded a parliamentary inquiry into the situation.
The closure of the Deeside store is expected to impact 150 local jobs.

A legal review of the situation is expected to be completed by January 2027.
